name: Media Types for any data encoding(s)
abstract: Clause 8: media types of the data encodings.
description:
> **NOTE** TODO — A section describing the MIME-types to be used is mandatory for any standard involving data
> encodings. If no suitable MIME type exists in
> <http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/index.html> then this section may be used to define
> a new MIME type for registration with IANA.
